top_signals.title: Dana Telsey on the Future of Department Stores
top_signals.summary: Dana Telsey, CEO and chief research officer of Telsey Advisory Group, says Nordstrom’s transition to private ownership was the right decision. Telsey points to improving business performance, a wider range of brands in stores, and faster growth at Nordstrom Rack. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on The Close. (Source: Bloomberg)
